terra.problem: The verse says Ahaz made the images, but it does not say he personally manufactured them or that making them was separate from copying the kings' ways.
The verse names the Baals but does not establish that Chemosh was absent from Ahaz's worship.
The claim that Moab was a neighbor of Judah is outside the passage and needs a reference.
“Wrong king” uses “wrong” about the baker's answer.
The explanation is generic, and the final observation about captives adds little.
This is a flat, generic correction with little of Papa Dorin's voice.
Oded asks about their guilt in the next verse, not a couple of verses later.
The faithfulness trophy joke makes light of the army's serious guilt.
The text says the feeble were put on donkeys, so the men did not walk all the captives there. It also says they brought them to their brothers in Jericho, not that they took each person home.
“Wrong stop” uses “wrong” about the baker's answer.
The claim that Egypt was a major power in the Bible is outside the passage and needs a reference.
The correction and the comment about kingdoms running together are generic and lack Papa Dorin's voice.
Ahaz giving Assyria a portion does not establish the opposite of a supposed refusal to pay. The passage does not discuss such a refusal.
“It pushed him the other way” says distress caused Ahaz's increased unfaithfulness. The text says he became more unfaithful during his distress, not why.
“For Ahaz they did the opposite” makes his hard times the cause of his increased unfaithfulness, which the text does not say.
Ahaz states that he wants help, but the text does not establish that he had no interest in peace.
The passage gives Ahaz's stated reason, but it does not say nobody ordered him or that the idea originated with him.
The explanation is a flat correction, and its last sentence merely repeats that nothing was repaired.
“Folks” addresses more than one baker. The modern mailbox-and-bench image also blends a modern city with the Bible setting.
The claim that Ophel is in Jerusalem is outside the passage and needs a reference.
